description: Burning and hot-block ticks. inFire covers fire and soul fire, campfires (vanilla and Tinted Campfires), Decorative Blocks bonfires and braziers, Vinery burning log piles and hot Salt cauldrons; hotFloor covers magma blocks, Immersive Weathering nulch and the Immersive Petroleum flarestack top; the stove ids cover Farmer's Delight, Nether's Delight and Ender's Delight stoves. Shields only attempt these on tiers with [shields.<tier>].blocksBurnTicks = true (netherite and above by default). An ownerless fireball also uses the onFire id; projectiles never count as ticks. Lava and Create fan fire are deliberately not here and keep using the tier's fire percentage.
